title: PRINCE antigen split: remote-homology audit and homology-clean rescore
question: cluster.py joins antigen chains on UniProt accession OR exact sequence only, so test clusters may still hold close homologues of train antigens. How much, and does the headline survive removing them?

sequence_receipt.source: local structure cache only; zero network calls
sequence_receipt.method: per-residue aa_XXX one-hot columns of the cache feature matrix argmax-decoded to a 1-letter sequence; residues grouped by the chain prefix of each cache key; aa_UNK -> X
sequence_receipt.caveat: MODELLED sequences: unresolved residues are absent and segments are collapsed, so a chain can be shorter than its SEQRES. This can only lower measured identity, so reported leakage is a floor.

identity_definition.coverage_corrected_identity: 100 * nident / min(qlen, slen), best single HSP
identity_definition.raw_pident: BLAST pident over the aligned region only (reported alongside)
identity_definition.qualifying_hsp: evalue <= 0.001 AND aln_length >= 50 AND aln_length >= 0.5 * min(qlen, slen); the 50-column floor relaxes to 0.5 * shorter when the shorter sequence is < 50 aa
identity_definition.permissive_sensitivity_variant: evalue <= 0.001 AND aln_length >= 25, no coverage requirement
identity_definition.multi_hsp: best single HSP by coverage-corrected identity; HSPs never summed
identity_definition.cluster_rule: a cluster max = max over its own chain sequences of the max over all train-split chain sequences
identity_definition.tool_limitation: blastp only; mmseqs/HHsearch not available on this machine, so the >=30% tier is a LOWER BOUND on true remote homology

identity_bands.band_definition: max coverage-corrected identity to any train antigen chain

70-90.caution: cluster-macro CI is wide at this cluster count

50-70.caution: cluster-macro CI is wide at this cluster count

30-50.caution: cluster-macro CI is wide at this cluster count

exact_leak_pairs.definition: test clusters holding an antigen chain whose MODELLED sequence is byte-identical to a train-split antigen chain; cluster.py did not join them because neither the UniProt accession nor the full SEQRES matched

pairs.class: viral strain variant, identical modelled region
same virus under two names (Dabie bandavirus == SFTSV)
